title: I've Been Working on a Zombies Survival Game for a Little While Now: Line of Fire Zombies
author: Critical_Hurry7268
selftext:
Line of Fire Zombies is a mixture of classic Zombies from Call of Duty with some original ideas, with two maps in it at the moment.

Available features include:

* Accounts (Google, save your progress!)
* Camos (over 100+ camo designs)
* A lot of Operator customization
* Co-Op Support (very early testing)
* Great performance
* In-game cutscenes
* In depth Easter Egg Quests
* And more...

  
[shooterofio.com](http://shooterofio.com)

The game is in Early Access and will be improved on, especially the Co-Op Matches, which is just getting implemented today. You can play Co-op right now but there are a handful of big bugs, which should be fixed by today.
